sources.limitation: Best PBR showcase results, classes 2024–26. Sample sizes unpublished. Some best results occurred after commitment.
Example report, page 6, outfielders during/after junior HS season. Cohort size and aggregation method unpublished. Top 100 D1 is not identical to Power conferences.
Rising senior summer cohort. Facility top fastball on Rapsodo. NAIA/JUCO pooled. Sample sizes and several stat denominators unpublished.
Published recruiting targets, not observed means. Testing context and sample sizes unspecified. Most lower D1 targets absent.
Recruiting guidelines, not averages. D1 pooled and D3/NAIA combined. Program exceptions acknowledged.
College four-seam TrackMan averages, not HS recruiting means. Years, counts, and weighting unpublished. NAIA LHP sample especially small.
2023 SEC game sample: 51 pitchers, five teams, 509 four-seam fastballs. First inning of appearances. Not a national mean.
Event formats differ. Some substitute home-to-first for a 60. Preserve the actual test.
EV and session average definitions only. No college recruiting thresholds.
Timing concept only. Showcase timing must be labeled separately from Statcast projected timing.
Metric definitions only. MLB thresholds do not establish college level means.
Spin profile interpretation. Pitch type and handedness matter. No seven-level recruiting averages.

recruit_average_datasets.population: Committed high school players, classes 2024–2026, best recorded PBR showcase measurements. Not averages of game performance.
Outfielders during/after junior high school season. Top 100, Mid Tier and Lower Tier are this report's own categories.
Slammers rising senior summer cohort. Top facility fastball measured on Rapsodo. JUCO and NAIA combined.

recruit_target_records.review_note: Source supplies 2.10+ for a lower-is-better metric. Do not interpret this as a minimum speed or manufacture an upper cutoff.

sec_research_sample.scope: First-inning four-seam fastballs from five SEC teams. Context only.

player_input_dictionary.name: Age at measurement
player_input_dictionary.definition: Store age for each test; also record current age.

player_input_dictionary.name: Graduation year
player_input_dictionary.definition: Expected high school graduation year.

player_input_dictionary.name: Primary position
player_input_dictionary.definition: P, C, 1B, 2B, SS, 3B, LF, CF, RF.

player_input_dictionary.name: Secondary position
player_input_dictionary.definition: Optional second evaluation; two-way players need two separate reads.

player_input_dictionary.name: Throws
player_input_dictionary.definition: Record pitching and fielding hand.

player_input_dictionary.name: Bats
player_input_dictionary.definition: Record hitting side; preserve side for split testing.

player_input_dictionary.name: Height
player_input_dictionary.definition: Measured standing height. Context, not an automatic ability grade.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: FG OF; SL age cohort; no universal cutoff

player_input_dictionary.name: Weight
player_input_dictionary.definition: Measured body weight with date. Context, not a minimum.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: FG OF; SL age cohort; no universal cutoff

player_input_dictionary.name: Competition context
player_input_dictionary.definition: High school or travel, age group, league, season, level of opponents.

player_input_dictionary.name: Measurement date
player_input_dictionary.definition: Required for every submitted measurement.

player_input_dictionary.name: Evidence source
player_input_dictionary.definition: Self report, event result, coach verification, or device report.

player_input_dictionary.name: Evidence link / upload
player_input_dictionary.definition: Original result or report. Keep owner/source traceable.

player_input_dictionary.name: Device / timing method
player_input_dictionary.definition: Radar, TrackMan, Rapsodo, sensor brand, laser/electronic or hand timing.

player_input_dictionary.name: Test environment
player_input_dictionary.definition: Game, showcase, bullpen, facility, tee, front toss, or live BP.

player_input_dictionary.name: Bat and ball conditions
player_input_dictionary.definition: Bat material/specification/length and ball type for hitting.

player_input_dictionary.name: Sample size
player_input_dictionary.definition: Swings, batted balls, throws, sprints, pitches, or games behind the number.

player_input_dictionary.name: Statistic type
player_input_dictionary.definition: Maximum, best, session mean, range midpoint, or season mean.

player_input_dictionary.name: Season and game format
player_input_dictionary.definition: Date range, innings per game, rules and schedule strength.

player_input_dictionary.name: Maximum exit velocity
player_input_dictionary.definition: Hardest valid measured batted ball.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: BP by position; FG OF; SL cohort; NC targets

player_input_dictionary.name: Average exit velocity
player_input_dictionary.definition: Mean EV over a defined set of tracked batted balls.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: No defensible seven-level recruit means found

player_input_dictionary.name: 90th-percentile exit velocity
player_input_dictionary.definition: 90th percentile of a defined batted-ball sample.

player_input_dictionary.name: Bat speed
player_input_dictionary.definition: Specify device and measurement definition; keep averages and maximum separate.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: No seven-level comparable sensor means found

player_input_dictionary.name: Launch angle
player_input_dictionary.definition: Record distribution alongside EV. No universal ideal average.

player_input_dictionary.name: Hard-hit rate
player_input_dictionary.definition: For MLB definition: batted balls at least 95 mph / tracked batted balls.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: Definition available; college recruiting means unavailable

player_input_dictionary.name: Contact rate
player_input_dictionary.definition: Bat-ball contact swings / swings. Define whether fouls count.

player_input_dictionary.name: Chase rate
player_input_dictionary.definition: Swings at outside-zone pitches / outside-zone pitches.

player_input_dictionary.name: Hitting raw totals
player_input_dictionary.definition: PA, AB, H, 2B, 3B, HR, BB, HBP, SO, SF. Preserve season and opponent context.

player_input_dictionary.name: Batting average
player_input_dictionary.definition: H / AB.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: SL cohort only; not a universal cutoff

player_input_dictionary.name: On-base percentage
player_input_dictionary.definition: (H + BB + HBP) / (AB + BB + HBP + SF).
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: SL cohort only; not a universal cutoff

player_input_dictionary.name: Slugging percentage
player_input_dictionary.definition: Total bases / AB.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: SL cohort only; not a universal cutoff

player_input_dictionary.name: OPS
player_input_dictionary.definition: OBP + SLG. Avoid counting OPS, OBP and SLG as independent tools.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: No national seven-level recruit means found

player_input_dictionary.name: Hitter walk rate
player_input_dictionary.definition: BB / PA for the estimator. Imported sources must use the same denominator.

player_input_dictionary.name: Hitter strikeout rate
player_input_dictionary.definition: SO / PA for the estimator.

player_input_dictionary.name: Stolen bases / attempts
player_input_dictionary.definition: Successful steals and total attempts; retain running context.

player_input_dictionary.name: 60-yard dash
player_input_dictionary.definition: Best verified time; record electronic vs hand start, surface and wind.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: BP OF/MIF; FG OF; NC targets

player_input_dictionary.name: 30-yard sprint
player_input_dictionary.definition: Measured 30-yard test; do not double it to manufacture a 60 time.

player_input_dictionary.name: 10-yard split
player_input_dictionary.definition: Timing protocol and start method required.

player_input_dictionary.name: Home-to-first
player_input_dictionary.definition: Game or test timing, hitting side, bunt vs full swing. Not interchangeable with 60.

player_input_dictionary.name: Vertical / broad jump
player_input_dictionary.definition: Strength-development context; define jump test.

player_input_dictionary.name: Fielding throwing velocity
player_input_dictionary.definition: Infield and outfield throwing tests are separate.

player_input_dictionary.name: Throw accuracy
player_input_dictionary.definition: Define target and distance; report attempts.

player_input_dictionary.name: Defensive actions / range
player_input_dictionary.definition: Game and skills video showing footwork, reads, hands, routes and repeatability.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: Qualitative review, not a numerical cutoff

player_input_dictionary.name: Catcher pop time, best
player_input_dictionary.definition: Pitch reception to throw arrival at second; valid accurate throw.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: BP mean of bests; NC/NS targets

player_input_dictionary.name: Catcher pop time, average
player_input_dictionary.definition: Mean over valid throws, with count and controlled/game setting.

player_input_dictionary.name: Catcher throwing velocity
player_input_dictionary.definition: Throw from catching position, not an IF/OF throw.

player_input_dictionary.name: Catcher exchange time
player_input_dictionary.definition: Glove receipt to release using an explicitly defined timing method.

player_input_dictionary.name: Caught-stealing rate
player_input_dictionary.definition: Caught steals / steal attempts, with pitcher delivery context.

player_input_dictionary.name: Receiving / blocking
player_input_dictionary.definition: Game video or documented opportunities and grading method.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: No comparable seven-level recruit means found

player_input_dictionary.name: Top fastball velocity
player_input_dictionary.definition: Highest valid measured mound fastball; preserve game/bullpen/facility context.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: BP bests; SL facility; NC targets

player_input_dictionary.name: Typical game fastball
player_input_dictionary.definition: Average/range over representative game pitches with innings and pitch count.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: PC college norms; no full seven-level recruit means

player_input_dictionary.name: Velocity retention
player_input_dictionary.definition: Fastball by inning or pitch-count segment; not only the highest reading.

player_input_dictionary.name: Pitch repertoire
player_input_dictionary.definition: Fastball variants, slider, curveball, changeup, cutter, splitter as applicable.

player_input_dictionary.name: Velocity by secondary pitch
player_input_dictionary.definition: Mean and top separately for each pitch type.

player_input_dictionary.name: Spin rate by pitch type
player_input_dictionary.definition: Average spin rate; evaluate with velocity, pitch type and movement.

player_input_dictionary.name: Spin efficiency
player_input_dictionary.definition: Use exact vendor definition and pitch type.

player_input_dictionary.name: Spin axis / direction
player_input_dictionary.definition: Preserve convention and handedness.

player_input_dictionary.name: Induced vertical break
player_input_dictionary.definition: Movement relative to a gravity-only trajectory; preserve vendor convention.

player_input_dictionary.name: Horizontal break
player_input_dictionary.definition: Preserve sign convention and pitch type.

player_input_dictionary.name: Extension
player_input_dictionary.definition: Release distance in front of rubber; device definition required.

player_input_dictionary.name: Release height / side
player_input_dictionary.definition: Release coordinates, pitch type and hand.

player_input_dictionary.name: Zone rate
player_input_dictionary.definition: Pitches crossing defined strike zone / tracked pitches.

player_input_dictionary.name: Strike rate
player_input_dictionary.definition: Called, swinging and other credited strikes / all pitches; preserve provider rules.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: SL cohort only; not zone rate

player_input_dictionary.name: First-pitch strike rate
player_input_dictionary.definition: Plate appearances starting with a strike / batters faced.

player_input_dictionary.name: Whiff rate
player_input_dictionary.definition: Swinging misses / swings.

player_input_dictionary.name: Swinging-strike rate
player_input_dictionary.definition: Swinging misses / total pitches. Distinct from whiff rate.

player_input_dictionary.name: Pitching raw totals
player_input_dictionary.definition: Outs recorded, batters faced, ER, H, BB, HBP, SO and pitch count.

player_input_dictionary.name: Pitcher strikeout rate
player_input_dictionary.definition: SO / batters faced.

player_input_dictionary.name: Pitcher walk rate
player_input_dictionary.definition: BB / batters faced.

player_input_dictionary.name: Strikeout-to-walk ratio
player_input_dictionary.definition: SO / BB; undefined when BB is zero, not a fabricated maximum.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: No national seven-level recruit means found

player_input_dictionary.name: ERA
player_input_dictionary.definition: 9 × ER / innings. Store outs to avoid interpreting 5.2 IP as 5.2 decimal.

player_input_dictionary.name: WHIP
player_input_dictionary.definition: (BB + H) / innings.

player_input_dictionary.name: Pitcher fielding / delivery
player_input_dictionary.definition: Command, secondary quality, delivery repeatability, fielding and holding runners.

player_input_dictionary.name: GPA and grading scale
player_input_dictionary.definition: Separate academic school fit from athletic level.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: No athletic-level mean should be used

player_input_dictionary.name: Core-course / eligibility status
player_input_dictionary.definition: Verify separately with the relevant governing body; no athletic ability bonus.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: No athletic-level mean should be used

player_input_dictionary.name: SAT / ACT
player_input_dictionary.definition: Optional school-specific admissions context.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: No athletic-level mean should be used

player_input_dictionary.name: Academic interests / budget
player_input_dictionary.definition: Optional school-list context, not athletic ability.
player_input_dictionary.benchmark_availability: No athletic-level mean should be used
